Authors' conclusions: moderate-quality evidence supports cannabinoids for chronic pain and spasticity; low-quality evidence suggests improvement in chemotherapy nausea and vomiting, weight gain in HIV, sleep disorders and Tourette syndrome; cannabinoids were associated with an increased risk of short-term adverse events; large robust trials, more trials of cannabis itself and standardized outcomes are needed.
